coach_note: Mon Nov 23 - Portofino. Yesterday's AMRAPs rewrote every baseline: decline push-ups 35 (was 15-20), regular 50 (was 30), row 90 x23, bridges 50 a side, leg lifts 30 slow. Cardio was long but easy - 75 min on the treadmill at avg HR 73 plus a 43-min walk, so the week still has 0 of its 45 Zone 2 minutes. Recovery is middling tonight: 6.4 h sleep, HRV 40, body battery 27, resting HR 49. So today: one real Zone 2 ride at 120-129 (not a stroll), then legs - last done Friday - with the top set of each machine taken past the number, and the week's first planks. No push-ups, no row: chest and back get until Wednesday.

exercises.note: 5 min easy, then 30 min holding 120-129 bpm - watch the number and add resistance until it sits there; yesterday never got above 84. 5 min easy. This is the week's Zone 2 in one go.

Friday was 70 and 85 x45 - 45 reps means the weight is far too light. Warm up at 85 x15, then 115 AMRAP: stop at the first rep where the knees cave or you lose depth. Target 20+; if you get 30, go to 135 next time.
Friday 55/70/90 x20/15/12. One warm-up, then 90 AMRAP with a 1-second hold at the top.
Friday 40/55/65 x15/15/10. Warm-up, then 65 AMRAP - hamstrings cramp when pushed, so stop at the first twinge, not at the burn.
Friday 50/60/70 x15. Warm-up at 50, then 70 AMRAP with a full stretch at the bottom and a 1-second squeeze at the top.
Friday's top set was 100 x20 with room to spare. Warm-up at 80, then 110 AMRAP.
Week's plank goal is 315 s and nothing is logged yet. One AMRAP hold - stop when the hips sag - then one 45-second hold.
